description: Creator collabs and cross-promotion — organic creator-to-creator partnerships that swap audiences. Use when someone wants to set up a collab, audience swap, cross-promotion, shoutout swap, joint giveaway, guest spot, joint video/series, a YouTube/IG collab post, or co-promo with another creator. Picks a complementary, similar-size, values-aligned partner, agrees the plan before creating, and co-creates shared-value content (not a bare shoutout) on a coordinated schedule. Uses the UNITE framework. Reads brand-profile + goals-and-kpis first. WoopSocial publishes each partner's OWN posts to their OWN accounts; it does NOT create native IG Collab co-authored posts, run giveaways, duet/stitch, or manage the agreement. A pure mutual collab isn't a sponsorship, but payment/free product makes it one -> disclose -> ugc-and-influencer; partnerships must be genuine; metrics never fabricated. Distinct from ugc-and-influencer (brand->creator) and creator-monetization (the creator's income).
